Casting an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill Pulls in Distant enemies, dealing {c:FF44A68E}[Affix_Flat_Value_1]{/c} Physical damage to them and increasing by {c:FF44A68E}[(Affix_Value_2 * 100)|%x|]{/c} for every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} |4point:points; of Willpower you have. This effect repeats once more {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds later.

Current Bonus: {c:FF44A68E}[Floor(Owner.Willpower_Total) * (Affix_Value_2 * 100) / Affix."Static Value 2"|x%|]{/c}
